documents.title: Rolling infrastructure rebuild — the old infrastructure builds the new
documents.summary: Rebuild service by service using the running homelab to provision its replacement; no big-bang rebuild, no full hardware duplication.

documents.title: pve-management is a standalone bootstrap, orchestration and recovery host
documents.summary: The fresh Proxmox host pve-management stays outside the compute cluster and runs only management VMs (IaC toolchain, runner, later Windmill/Phase).
headings: ADR-002: pve-management as a standalone host

documents.title: OpenTofu for new infrastructure roots; legacy Terraform roots migrate individually
documents.summary: New roots use OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox; existing Terraform roots keep Terraform until each is migrated with a verified no-change plan.

documents.title: Phase for runtime secrets, SOPS + age for bootstrap and recovery secrets
documents.summary: Phase is the intended Infisical replacement (pending capability and licence validation); SOPS+age protects bootstrap material so recovery never needs Phase, Forgejo or Windmill.
headings: ADR-004: Secrets — Phase at runtime, SOPS + age for bootstrap

documents.title: Windmill is the operations UI over a versioned service catalog
documents.summary: Each service declares a service.yaml catalog entry whose input schema drives a Windmill form; Windmill triggers versioned workflows and never replaces OpenTofu, Ansible or Forgejo.
headings: ADR-005: Windmill over a versioned service catalog

documents.title: Docker Compose first; k3s and Argo CD later, only where they add value
documents.summary: Applications run as Compose projects on VMs; k3s with Argo CD is a future option. Supersedes the legacy K3s/Flux-first direction.

documents.title: Archive the legacy Codex workflow; keep live legacy IaC roots in place until migrated
documents.summary: Old AGENTS.md, roadmap, tasks and docs moved verbatim to docs/archive/codex-2026; legacy Terraform/Ansible code that still manages live resources stays at its path.
headings: ADR-007: Archive the legacy workflow, keep live roots

documents.title: Target homelab platform architecture
documents.summary: Layers, tool responsibilities, target stack, pve-management role, service catalog model, secrets and recovery boundaries for the rebuild.
headings: Migrate an existing service (per service, M005)

documents.title: homelab-iac — project overview
documents.summary: Vision, rolling-rebuild strategy, scope and navigation for the homelab rebuild; read first.

documents.title: Legacy homelab inventory (from the archived repository, unverified)
documents.summary: Hosts, guests, services and local Terraform states as described by the legacy repo at 915333c; starting point for the M000 live inventory, not current truth.
headings: Local Terraform state (verified on the operator workstation, 2026-11-12)

documents.title: Infrastructure inventory and migration planning
documents.summary: Accurate live inventory of hosts, guests, services, data and backups, and a migration order that avoids unnecessary downtime.
headings: M000 — Infrastructure inventory and migration planning

documents.title: Bootstrap pve-management
documents.summary: Existing infrastructure provisions and configures a management VM on pve-management automatically, with recoverable state and bootstrap secrets.

documents.title: Secrets infrastructure (Phase)
documents.summary: Phase deployed, recoverable independently, and used by deployment automation; controlled migration from Infisical begins.

documents.title: Workflow automation (Windmill)
documents.summary: A Windmill workflow initiates an approved IaC operation from a service-catalog form and reports its outcome.

documents.title: New compute infrastructure
documents.summary: The new compute environment can reliably host and restore migrated applications.

documents.title: Rolling application migration
documents.summary: Existing services are progressively replaced without a complete homelab outage; emptied hosts are reinstalled and joined.

documents.title: Observability and platform improvements
documents.summary: Prometheus, Loki and Grafana give useful health checks, dashboards, logs and alerts, outside the bootstrap path.

documents.title: Core service cutover and retirement
documents.summary: Foundational services run on the new platform, recovery works without the original cluster, and the old environment is decommissioned.
headings: M007 — Core service cutover and retirement

documents.title: Advanced capabilities (future)
documents.summary: Future evaluation: k3s + Argo CD, self-service deployment forms and service catalog, automated node reinstallation, advanced DR.

documents.title: Reset repository to the agent harness and record the rebuild direction
documents.summary: Install the agent harness, archive the legacy Codex workflow, and document vision, architecture, decisions and roadmap.
headings: TASK-001 — Reset repository to the agent harness and record the rebuild direction

documents.title: Live read-only inventory of Proxmox hosts, guests and storage
documents.summary: Verify hosts, cluster membership, VMs/LXCs, storage and capacity on every node; correct the legacy inventory.
headings: TASK-002 — Live read-only inventory of Proxmox hosts, guests and storage

documents.title: Service dependency, network/DNS and data/backup map
documents.summary: Map every service's dependencies (DNS, proxy, auth, secrets, storage), its persistent data and its backup coverage.
headings: TASK-003 — Service dependency, network/DNS and data/backup map

documents.title: Representative PBS restore test
documents.summary: Restore one representative guest backup from PBS to an isolated, disposable target and verify it boots and holds its data.

documents.title: Migration order and bootstrap credential requirements
documents.summary: Decide the service migration order and list every bootstrap credential and recovery prerequisite.
headings: TASK-005 — Migration order and bootstrap credential requirements

documents.title: Target repository layout, OpenTofu toolchain and service catalog schema
documents.summary: Create the target layout (modules/, stacks/, services/, windmill/), pin OpenTofu, and define the service.yaml schema with offline validation.
headings: TASK-006 — Target repository layout, OpenTofu toolchain and service catalog schema

documents.title: Scoped Proxmox API token and SSH access for pve-management
documents.summary: Define and verify the dedicated automation identity, role and token on pve-management, and SSH access for Ansible.
headings: TASK-007 — Scoped Proxmox API token and SSH access for pve-management

documents.title: Reusable OpenTofu guest module and management VM root
documents.summary: Write modules/opentofu/proxmox-guest (bpg/proxmox, cloud-init) and the stacks/management root that creates the Ubuntu management VM.
headings: TASK-008 — Reusable OpenTofu guest module and management VM root

documents.title: Ansible baseline for the management VM (toolchain and runner)
documents.summary: Configure the management VM with Ansible: users, SSH hardening, OpenTofu, Ansible, SOPS/age, CLI tools, and a dedicated Forgejo runner.
headings: TASK-009 — Ansible baseline for the management VM (toolchain and runner)

documents.title: OpenTofu state management and backups
documents.summary: Choose the state backend for new roots and back up the existing legacy local states outside the operator workstation.
headings: TASK-010 — OpenTofu state management and backups

documents.title: SOPS + age bootstrap secrets
documents.summary: Introduce .sops.yaml, an encrypted secrets/bootstrap/ file for the Proxmox token and SSH material, and decryption in Ansible/OpenTofu workflows.

documents.title: Independent bootstrap and recovery runbook
documents.summary: Write and exercise the runbook that rebuilds the management VM from a clean workstation.
headings: TASK-012 — Independent bootstrap and recovery runbook
